strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
It works... it works... my Apsaras. With this perfected model...!
Aina, in the end, you betrayed your own brother.
I will prove how wrong your foolish choice was...!
Wh-What is that monster!? A new Zeon weapon!?
A Zaku head...! So it's that Apsaras mobile armor we fought...?
They still had forces left!?
It's... strange, isn't it.
I doubt the Zeon ground forces right now could afford
to keep this much strength in reserve...
...!! That's...! How!?
Even in its final stage, it shouldn't be able to move so easily...
Aina, that's... the Apsaras...
Its completed form... It's strange. They shouldn't have that much left...
True... it's strange. Don't tell me, Haman's forces on Earth!?
There's no sign they've joined up. ...Something's off.
The Zeon ground forces... might be getting aid independently
from somewhere besides Haman...
What the heck!
With all these gun emplacements, not a single one fires back!
Are they just for show!?
Doesn't that prove Jaburo isn't functioning?
It's really thorough.
Damn, this makes less and less sense! What's going on inside Jaburo?
Ngh, all these gun emplacements... and every one of them silent.
They've shut down completely. Even these outlying pillboxes...
I'm starting to wonder what's going on inside Jaburo...
Commander Hazuki... I'm going out.
Is that... Aina!? Heh heh... I see.
Behold! This is the Apsaras's true form, Aina!
What kinda design is that... It ain't normal...
Like... a devil.
Amuro... this mobile armor...
Yes, it resembles the Big Zam from the One Year War.
Which means the power of the Mega Particle Cannon in its body...
This... for something like this... I...
Aina...
Hmm...? You!? If only you weren't around...!
Aina, a parting gift from your brother... I'll send you off together.
Brother... no more... no more...
Aina, let's go. We'll settle this with our own hands...
You can't run from facing your brother...!
What a nuisance! Here they come again!
Struggling... Iron Mask, do you think a machine this outdated
will work forever...
That round one! It showed up again!
Tch, one after another...!
That humanoid... a mobile suit? I've never seen that model... A new type?
Its concept seems different from Zeonic's mobile suits, though...
Come to think of it... I've seen those in space.
It's not the Zeon military?
Pretty sure it's not. What were they called... Mia, remember?
...Something Vanguard... I think...
The Crossbone Vanguard!
Yeah, yeah, that's it!
What are they, Commander?
Captain Bright gave me the data. The Earth Sphere's turmoil is settling...
and they chose that moment to move. Details later!
For now, focus on defeating them one by one.
Another new faction. Damn, when will I ever reach the Devil Gundam...!
So that's it. The ones moving around Lord Ginias...
were the Crossbone Vanguard.
Norris?
You didn't know?
I knew he was receiving aid from somewhere, but...
And I thought it was almost over!
Things ain't that easy.
They're small and look like a pain... but let's do it, Hayato! Benkei!
Is this really the time for humans to fight each other?
Can't be helped.
...Fools. Oh, well...
If we'll clash in earnest eventually, gauging their strength isn't bad.
I'll take Iron Mask's actions... in a positive light.
Tobikage!
You're late! The enemy's sick of waiting, y'know!?
Well, a late arrival, I see.
Here they come! Show! Don't lose, use your clones!
Easy for you to say!
I underestimated them... Withdrawing.
The Crossbone Vanguard... siding with Zeon, of all things...
I wonder about that. Bright didn't mention anything.
Maybe... they were only helping the Zeon ground forces.
So they're unrelated to Neo Zeon... to Haman Karn?
I don't know. But something smells fishy...
We're so close to storming Jaburo...
but there's so much to worry about.
Even so, all we can do is push forward.
The people of Londo Bell are doing their best too... so must we.
Aina...?
...Goodbye, Brother.
Gh... nn... those... wretches... I won't let them... into Jaburo... ugh...
Still alive...? Indeed, such tenacity... might be of some use...
Iron Mask, what are you thinking?
Ugh... ggh...
No choice... I'll take him along.
